pkgmetadata.longdescription: The ROCm/llvm-project fork (amd-staging) at the TheRock release tag, built the way TheRock builds it: clang and lld only, AMDGPU and X86 targets, assertions off, installed self-contained under /usr/lib/llvm/roc. Version tracks the ROCm release, not LLVM's. The ROCm 10 userspace (rocm-comgr, rocm-device-libs, hipcc, hip, rocr-runtime) builds against this instead of ::gentoo's llvm slot.
